transport_scope.container_note: Containerization is a cross-modal cargo, equipment or route attribute, not a separate transport mode

product.excluded_product: terminals, bonded warehouses, rail sidings, container sales and infrastructure marketplace

confirmed_decisions: exim.kz is the first full tenant but not the only possible organization
Private Operating OS and the freight and available transport exchange are separate product contours; current contour names are working labels
An organization may combine multiple Exchange functions instead of choosing one mutually exclusive type
The platform is not a party to transactions between independent Exchange participants
Exchange has a limited free tier and paid access
The current EXIM operating workflow remains the first tenant configuration
Client data is separated from internal cost, margin, contractors and comments
proposed_guardrails: Until OQ-038 is closed, private requests and public listings remain separate and no automatic publication is assumed
open_questions: Exchange module versus separately deployed microservice
Free and paid limits and billing provider
Exchange listing and response lifecycle details
Whether verification, KYC, moderation, ratings, fraud and dispute mechanisms are required, and their scope if approved
When other companies receive the full Private Operating OS
Whether and how a private request may create or populate an Exchange listing
Final product and Exchange names and future ownership/operator structure
Geographic market rollout after the first full tenant
